description: Invite a member or client to a workspace. Returns the invitation URL and, by default, emails the invitation to the invitee; send_email=false creates the invitation without sending the email. Retry-safe: a repeat call with the same idempotency_key returns the original result.

body.description: Optional body override for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

query.description: Optional query overrides for endpoints with sparse parameter schemas.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to operate in: the `id` of a workspace returned by aidelly_list_workspaces. Optional for read operations; required when creating content.

name: aidelly_invite_workspace_member
title: Invite Workspace Member
